farm_pond.label: new farm ponds
farm_pond.note: 65 new farm ponds in Mul tehsil raised cropping intensity in their zones of influence by about 7.1 points on average (95% range +1.2 to +13.8), compared with the prediction had they not been built. 18 show a likely gain or an early sign of one and 7 a loss, against about 6 each expected by chance. Ponds whose water looks lined: +16.2 points (8 ponds); unlined: +3.5 points (22). Rabi and summer cropping changed by +2.8 points of the zones' cropland. In 2023-24 and 2024-25, with only the micro-watersheds left as comparison, the 73 ponds with data in those years show +6.5 points (an early sign).
